title: Egyptian-Style Oat Pilaf
description: A flavorful and hearty Mexican-inspired oat pilaf dish, incorporating Egyptian spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add 1 cup of Egyptian-style pilaf and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted.
Add 1 cup of oats and cook, stirring frequently, for 2 minutes.
Add 1 tsp of zesty Mexican seasoning and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes, or until oats have absorbed liquid and pilaf is tender.
Fluff pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
